---
title: "anchors thaw"
description: "Thaw the project, or a frozen part of it"
---

<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Thaw the project, or a frozen part of it.

```text
With a freeze's code, removes every mark of it and its record in the doctrine:

  anchors thaw QLDTQ-F01

With a scope, removes the marks at those places, whatever they carry — the way to thaw a
freeze whose marks carry their reason, in a project with no doctrine:

  anchors thaw --unit PAWAP --rule CARTU-B02 --file src/flags.ts

With neither, undoes the project's brake ('anchors freeze' with no scope): removes the freeze
from anchors.yaml, deletes the ruleset and closes the issue.

The commit and the push go out with --no-verify for the same reason as the freeze: while the
remote still says 'frozen', the hooks would refuse the thaw itself.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors thaw [freeze code] [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--file` |  | remove the freeze mark of a file's header (repeatable) |
| `--no-push` |  | do not commit or push anchors.yaml |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--rule` |  | remove the freeze mark of one rule (repeatable) |
| `--unit` |  | remove the freeze marks of a unit's header (repeatable) |

## Congelar o projeto — família

Comandos da mesma família — o que distingue cada um:

| Comando | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors freeze`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/freeze/) | Freeze the project, or a part of it, until `anchors thaw` |
| **`anchors thaw`** | Thaw the project, or a frozen part of it |

<!-- cli-reference:end -->
